categories.main_business_segments: Youngone Holdings operates primarily as a pure holding company overseeing subsidiaries engaged in outdoor and sports apparel manufacturing and sales, premium bicycle brand distribution, and domestic retail of outdoor brands. Key subsidiaries include Youngone (OEM manufacturing of outdoor apparel, footwear, backpacks), Scott (premium bicycle and sports equipment brand), and Youngone Outdoor (domestic retail of The North Face brand). The company also invests in startups through its Singapore-based YOH CVC to foster future growth and synergy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies including high-functionality fabric development, seamless bonding (CWS) technology, and vertical integration from fabric production to finished goods to enhance productivity and reduce lead times. Scott focuses on innovative bicycle frame technologies, including patented full suspension bike frames. The holding company is also developing industry-specific IT systems such as integrated ERP and MES to improve operational efficiency across subsidiaries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Youngone serves approximately 40 global outdoor and sports brands including The North Face, Lululemon, and Patagonia as OEM clients. Scott targets premium bicycle markets primarily in Europe and the US. The domestic retail segment caters to Korean consumers through direct stores and online channels. The company’s markets span outdoor apparel, sports footwear, backpacks, and premium bicycles, addressing both B2B (brand clients) and B2C (retail customers) segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in Bangladesh, Vietnam, El Salvador, Ethiopia, and Uzbekistan, and sales offices in the US, Europe, Japan, and Singapore. Scott’s bicycle sales are concentrated in Europe and the US. The domestic retail business is focused on South Korea. The holding company also manages investments and IT development activities across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Youngone Holdings functions primarily as a holding and management entity upstream in the supply chain, owning and guiding subsidiaries involved in manufacturing (OEM production), brand management, and retail distribution. Its subsidiaries operate midstream and downstream activities including fabric production, apparel manufacturing, brand marketing, and retail sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include strengthening subsidiaries’ competitiveness through continuous investment in production facilities and productivity improvements, expanding product categories (e.g., footwear, backpacks, functional knitwear), and developing integrated IT systems (ERP, MES) tailored to the fashion and textile industry. Scott focuses on innovation in premium bicycle technology and expanding e-bike offerings. The holding company also pursues sustainable growth via startup investments and eco-friendly production initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Youngone Holdings generates revenue mainly from dividends, rental income, and management fees from subsidiaries. Subsidiaries earn revenue through OEM product sales to global brands, wholesale distribution of bicycles, and direct retail sales of outdoor apparel and equipment. The company also plans to monetize proprietary IT systems and consulting services developed for its group companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the outdoor apparel OEM sector, Youngone competes with other large-scale manufacturers that combine product development and manufacturing capabilities, maintaining competitiveness through cost efficiency and technological differentiation. Scott holds a strong position as a premium bicycle brand in Europe, competing with other high-end bicycle manufacturers. The domestic retail segment competes in a mature Korean outdoor market dominated by established brands like The North Face.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the consolidated company reported revenues of approximately KRW 4.36 trillion with operating profit of KRW 872.6 billion. The holding company’s total assets reached KRW 6.38 trillion, showing growth in assets and equity. While overall revenue and profit declined slightly due to global market uncertainties and demand slowdown, the domestic retail segment showed significant growth. The company maintains a healthy capital structure with a debt ratio around 39%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Youngone emphasizes high functionality and technological innovation in its outdoor apparel, leveraging proprietary fabric technologies and seamless bonding methods. Scott differentiates through premium, innovative bicycle designs and a broad product portfolio including e-bikes. The domestic retail business capitalizes on strong brand heritage, product innovation, and sustainability initiatives such as recycled materials and ethical down standards. The holding company enhances group competitiveness via integrated IT solutions and strategic investments.
